section: Important things you should keep in mind about these benefits:
headers: You pay After the calendar year deductible…

rows.Benefits Description: Provided when medically necessary following brain injury or traumatic brain injury. Services will only be covered when provided by the following while practicing within their scope of care: • Speech, occupational and/or physical therapists • Psychologists • Physicians
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 35% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Benefits Description: • For treatment related to illness or injury, including evaluation and diagnostic hearing tests performed by an M.D., D.O., or audiologist.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 35% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Benefits Description: Not covered: • Hearing services that are not shown as covered • Over-the-counter hearing aids, enhancement devices, accessories or supplies

• First pair of contact lenses or standard ocular implant lenses if required to correct an impairment existing after intraocular surgery or accidental injury. • Diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the eye. • Outpatient vision therapy for treatment of convergence insufficiency up to a maximum of 24 visits per year for ages 5-18.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 35% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Benefits Description: Deductible will be waived in-network for this screening and diagnosis: • Retinopathy screening with a diagnosis of diabetes
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance (no deductible) Out-of-network: 35% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Benefits Description: Not covered: • Eyeglasses or contact lenses and examinations for them, except for the supplemental vision plan • Radial keratotomy and other refractive surgeries • Special multifocal ocular implant lenses • Vision therapy except as noted above • Eye exercises and orthoptics
